content.items.sword.description: Deals 10 physical damage in a 120-degree forward cone every 1.5 seconds.
content.items.laser.name: Laser
content.items.laser.description: Instantly kills a non-boss enemy every 9 seconds.
content.items.galactic_rifle.name: Galactic Rifle
content.items.galactic_rifle.description: Every 22 seconds, hits the enemy with the most current health for 20% of its current health (5% for bosses) as physical damage.
content.items.accelerator.name: Accelerator
content.items.accelerator.description: Every 27.18 seconds, gain 50% movement speed for 3.14 seconds and deal 16.1 physical damage on contact with enemies.

content.items.sausages.name: Sausages
content.items.sausages.description: A friendly dog fetches XP within 1000.
content.items.fpv_drone.name: FPV Drone
content.items.fpv_drone.description: The drone flies into an enemy, explodes for 35 physical damage in radius 100, and respawns after 10 seconds.
content.items.bait.name: Bait
content.items.bait.description: Every 10 seconds, summons a 150 HP boar. Its poison spits for 20 magical damage and slows by 25% in radius 120.
content.items.death_eagle.name: Death Eagle
content.items.death_eagle.description: Every 10 seconds, the eagle dives at a random enemy for 50 physical damage and a 0.3-second stun in radius 150.
content.items.leech.name: Leech
content.items.leech.description: Every 60 seconds, summons a creature that transfers its 200 HP to you at 20 HP per second.
content.items.satanic_bible.name: Satanic Bible
content.items.satanic_bible.description: Hits have a 16% chance to turn a non-boss enemy into an allied demon. Demons live 11 seconds and deal 22 pure damage twice per second.
content.items.wooden_stick.name: Wooden Stick
content.items.wooden_stick.description: Deals 30 to 55 pure damage and slows enemies in radius 550. Both effects are stronger near you.
content.items.wild_aura.name: Wild Aura
content.items.wild_aura.description: Slows enemies by 25% within 150 and deals 20 magical damage per second.
content.items.flamethrower.name: Flamethrower
content.items.flamethrower.description: Burns enemies in a forward 120-degree cone for 25 magical damage per second. Runs for 5 seconds, then cools for 3 seconds.
content.items.trident.name: Trident
content.items.trident.description: Every 7 seconds, throws a returning trident at speed 75 to range 200. It deals 30 physical damage to enemies it pierces.
content.items.magic_projectile.name: Magic Projectile
content.items.magic_projectile.descripti: Fires at a random enemy for 25 magical damage. On a kill it bounces to an enemy within 500.
content.items.soda.name: Soda
content.items.soda.description: Every 3 seconds, leaves a bottle that explodes after 2 seconds for 15 magical damage in radius 50.
content.items.cane.name: Cane
content.items.cane.description: Basic attacks have a 0.5% chance to execute the enemy with the most health, with a 30-second cooldown. Deals 165 pure damage to bosses.
content.items.rocket.name: Rocket
content.items.rocket.description: Basic attacks have a 25% chance to fire a rocket for 33% of the attack's damage as physical damage.
content.items.electric_gloves.name: Electric Gloves
content.items.electric_gloves.descriptio: Basic attacks have a 20% chance to fire lightning for 15 magical damage. It can bounce up to 5 times.
content.items.dominator_helm.name: Dominator Helm
content.items.dominator_helm.description: Allies within 765 gain 13 percentage points of armor and have a 7% chance to block physical damage.
content.items.welding_mask.name: Welding Mask
content.items.welding_mask.description: 15% chance to block any hit, with a 0.25-second cooldown. Limits vision to a 45-degree cone.
content.items.spiked_boots.name: Spiked Boots
content.items.spiked_boots.description: Allies in radius 325 gain 30 attack speed. Physical hits above 35 damage have a 7% chance to be redirected to the attacker.
content.items.icicle.name: Icicle
content.items.icicle.description: Kills have a 13% chance to trigger a freezing blast for 30 magical damage. The icicle it leaves restores 30% of current health.
content.items.dumbbell.name: Dumbbell
content.items.dumbbell.description: Within 250, allies gain 125 maximum health and summons gain 50.
content.items.blue_cheese.name: Blue Cheese
content.items.blue_cheese.description: Hits have a 33% chance to poison enemies, dealing an additional 6.5% damage as delayed magical damage.
content.items.fan.name: Fan
content.items.fan.description: Gain 15 movement speed. Enemies behind you are slowed by 20%.
content.items.executioner_blade.name: Executioner's Blade

content.items.jetpack.name: Jetpack

content.items.shared_heart.description: Recover 10% of health restored to allies and 5% of health restored to summons.
content.items.motivation_mask.name: Motivation Mask
content.items.motivation_mask.descriptio: Allies within 300 deal 15% more physical damage.
content.items.jar_of_wind.name: Jar of Wind
content.items.vampire_hood.name: Vampire Hood

content.items.poor_mans_shield.descripti: Every 12 seconds, grants a 50-point shield to the ally with the lowest current health.
content.items.sight.name: Sight
content.items.sight.description: Deal 11% more damage to the enemy with the most current health.
content.items.totem.name: Totem
content.items.totem.description: Heals allied summons within 500 for 1 HP per second.
content.items.leaders_heart.name: Leader's Heart
content.items.fb_ring.name: F.B. Ring
content.items.inverted_cross.name: Inverted Cross
content.items.inverted_cross.description: Prevents one death, restores all health, and grants 3.5 seconds of invulnerability. Consumed on use.
content.items.gold_vein_heart.name: Heart of the Gold Vein
content.items.gold_vein_heart.descriptio: Every second chest offers a third reward.
content.items.phantom_mask.name: Phantom Mask
content.items.phantom_mask.description: Kills have a 10% chance to create a copy for 4 seconds. The copy mirrors attacks at 25% damage. Limit one.
content.items.broken_clock.name: Broken Clock
content.items.broken_clock.description: Every 13 seconds, resets one item that is on cooldown.
content.items.devourer_heart.name: Devourer's Heart
content.items.devourer_heart.description: Below 15% health, devours a random non-boss enemy and heals 20% of maximum health. Cooldown 35 seconds.

content.characters.vampire.name: Vampire

content.characters.puppeteer.growth: +1 percentage point to both bonuses per level.

content.characters.masochist.passive: Missing health boosts regeneration and movement speed.
content.characters.masochist.growth: Each level adds up to 0.15 HP/s regeneration and 0.3% movement speed.
content.characters.diver.name: Diver
content.characters.diver.passive: Fixed movement speed. Distance travelled increases armor.
content.characters.diver.growth: +0.25 percentage points of damage reflection per level.
content.characters.skater.name: Skater
content.characters.skater.passive: Moves 25% faster and leaves a 3 s fire trail that deals 5 damage per second.
content.characters.skater.growth: +1 percentage point of movement speed and +3 trail DPS per level.
content.characters.illusionist.name: Illusionist

content.characters.illusionist.growth: +0.25 percentage points of copied damage per level.
